name: DeepFilterNet
tagline: Cleans up a voice recording: it takes out hiss, hum and room noise and leaves the voice sounding natural, so a phone recording can pass for a studio one.
author: Hendrik Schröter
install: Download the deep-filter binary for your platform from the GitHub releases (or pip install deepfilternet)
settled: Finished, not abandoned: last push October 2024, but about 42,000 PyPI downloads a month (month to 28 Oct 2026) and 4,900 GitHub stars. The 0.5.6 binary has no dependencies to break, and it only processes your own recordings. Reviewed 2026-10-28.
